definitions.explanation: A national holiday on the day of the autumn equinox, around September 22 or 23, set aside for honoring one's ancestors and remembering the dead. The exact date is fixed each year by astronomical calculation.

examples.japanese: {秋分|しゅうぶん}の{日|ひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{祝日|しゅくじつ}→祝日：07588_shukujitsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Autumnal Equinox Day is a national holiday.

examples.japanese: {秋分|しゅうぶん}の{日|ひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{墓参|はかまい}り→お墓参り：15303_ohakamairi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: On Autumnal Equinox Day our family visits the grave.

examples.japanese: {秋分|しゅうぶん}の{日|ひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{境|さかい}→境：02822_sakai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧いく。
examples.english: From Autumnal Equinox Day on, the nights grow longer than the days.

notes:
The day falls in the middle of the autumn ⟦{彼岸|ひがん}→彼岸：12612_higan⟧, the week around the equinox when many families visit graves and eat ⟦おはぎ→おはぎ：29365_ohagi⟧.
